title: docs(qa): RUNNER's connector self-URL entry follows the compile, not the boot's OS_PORT

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XAvhM3jY1jCc9QWVrVgRVuA)_

domain:devx#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ngu3885adndgvQofR

Fixes #33371

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` 里「showcase 自连连接器」那一条。旧文说导出 `OS_PORT` 就能修好,新文写明实测事实:连接器地址在编译时定下,`--no-compile` 启动时导出 `OS_PORT` 不起作用。两条可行路线都实测过,并写明哪条在共享检出上安全。另补一段端口被占时自动顺延的说明。
- 为什么改:旧文和 RUNNER 自己「共享检出用 `--no-compile`」的规定互相矛盾,照做的跑测会把正确的产品判成 BLOCKED。产品行为与 `self-url.ts` 头注释一致,过时的是 RUNNER。
- 风险与回滚:只改一份 QA 文档,不动产品、不发布。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`RUNNER.md` 连接器条目里的「Two routes work」两条路线,以及「A held port moves the boot」那一段。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` only:

- The connector self-URL entry is rewritten. The new headline says the connectors dial the self-URL the artifact was **compiled** with, so on a `--no-compile` boot an exported `OS_PORT` does not move it. The entry no longer prescribes `OS_PORT` as the fix there. Instead it says plainly that neither `OS_PORT` nor `SHOWCASE_SELF_URL` is read until the next compile.
- It names two routes, each measured below, and says which is safe on a shared checkout. Route 1 compiles in a private copy and is safe. Route 2 uses the default compile on the tree, which rewrites the shared `dist/objectstack.json`, so it is only for a checkout no other runner boots.
- It keeps the warning that `fetch failed` impersonates an egress block. The QA run #25817 reading (at `6679644a`) is now dated as pre-#26130 and marked as no longer holding. The `2889760a` paragraph is dropped because the measured entry supersedes it.
- The stale "`-p` alone is not enough" headline is gone: `os dev` exports `-p` for its compile (`portFlagEnv`), and that was measured below.
- New paragraph on the port shift: `os dev` takes the next free port and prints it twice, while the runner's shell keeps its `OS_PORT`. Runners should read the port from the boot log.
- Two pointers: the `--no-compile` entry's #33025 sentence now points at the connector entry, and the canonical boot line says a connector run boots a private copy that compiles.

`self-url.ts`, the showcase connectors, the CLI, `scripts/qa/**` and `areas/*.json` are untouched.

## Why

At `e0ce1b52` the product matches `self-url.ts`'s own header, which says the metadata is served "as last built" under `os dev --no-compile` (leg A below). RUNNER's entry was the stale part.

## Tests — live measurements

All legs ran at `origin/main` `e0ce1b52` after `pnpm build --concurrency=2` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0, 119/119). Each probe signs in as the seeded admin and creates a `showcase_task`. It then reads the newest run from `GET /api/v1/automation/showcase_declarative_connector_ping/runs`, then `GET /api/v1/meta/connector/showcase_status_api`, then `/api/v1/health` uptime.

| leg | boot | artifact | ping run | metadata `baseUrl` | shared tree artifact |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A — the freeze | tree, `--no-compile --no-watch -p 41781`, `OS_PORT=41781` exported | compiled with no `OS_PORT` (`127.0.0.1:3000` ×4) | **failed**, `connector_action(showcase_status_api.request) failed: fetch failed` | `http://127.0.0.1:3000` | — |
| B — route 1 | private copy (`cp -a` and an absolute `node_modules` symlink), default compile, `--no-watch -p 41782`, `OS_PORT=41782` | `Compiling …` once; copy's artifact `127.0.0.1:41782` ×3 | **completed**, ping step success, `ping.body` uptime 7.4 s (health 13.6 s six seconds later) | `http://127.0.0.1:41782` | sha256 `04d18b8a9def596a…`, mtime 1794681892 before and after |
| B′ — route 1, `-p` only | same copy, `OS_PORT`/`PORT` unset, `-p 41786` | `127.0.0.1:41786` ×3 | **completed**, uptime 9.6 s (health 15.8 s) | `http://127.0.0.1:41786` | — |
| C — port shift | same copy, 41783 held by a listener, `-p 41783`, `OS_PORT=41783` | `127.0.0.1:41784` ×3 | **completed**, uptime 10.2 s (health 16.4 s) | `http://127.0.0.1:41784` | — |
| D — route 2 | tree, default compile, `--no-watch -p 41785`, `OS_PORT=41785` | `Compiling …` once; the tree's artifact rewritten | **completed**, uptime 9.7 s (health 15.8 s) | `http://127.0.0.1:41785` | sha256 → `edbbc9076e31ccf8…`, port 41785 baked in ×3 |

The one `127.0.0.1:3000` left in a recompiled artifact is the OpenAPI document's `servers[0].url`. The artifact's own note says the connector's `baseUrl` overrides it on every dispatch.

In leg C the log printed `⚠ Port 41783 is in use — serving on 41784 instead.` at line 6, before the compile, and `↪ server bound to port 41784 (requested 41783)` at line 171.

Every boot ran under `setsid` and was stopped by its process group, read from the listener; each port was free afterwards. Leg D ran in this dev's own worktree, not a shared one. No ablation was owed: the diff is docs only (os-dev.md).

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: `docs/qa/**` ships in no package (root `private: true`).
- The branch was restarted from `origin/main` after #33367 merged (as `98c3a80440`). This PR's diff is only this card's two commits.
